reason: A dsh web toolbox focused on session, workspace, search, archive, preset, and configuration management, with optional scheduled AI heartbeats and IM delivery.

summaries.zh: 用于 dsh Web 的工具箱插件，提供会话与工作区管理、搜索、归档、预设和配置编辑，并支持可选的定时 AI 心跳与消息推送。
summaries.en: A dsh Web toolbox for managing sessions and workspaces, searching and archiving content, editing presets and configuration, and optionally scheduling AI heartbeats with message delivery.

capabilities: Manage, move, copy, archive, restore, and delete sessions and subdirectories
Read and search session contents, including optional semantic search
Edit agent preset files and dsh configuration files
Schedule AI heartbeat tasks and optionally push results to WeChat, QQ, or Feishu
Render long messages in collapsible sections
